correctness.rationale: For a!=b, the Laplacian splits into two dark leaf-contrast eigenspaces (eigenvalues a and b) and an orthogonal three-dimensional bright sector (simple eigenvalues 0 and the positive quadratic roots). Direct diagonal-moment computation gives det T=ab[a(p-1)(p+1-q)-b(q-1)(q+1-p)], nonzero for p+q>=3 and a!=b, forcing full bright-square rank. Each dark class of size m has contrast Schur-square eigenvalue 1-2/m, vanishing exactly at m=2. For a=b, merging groups gives two independent bright profiles and positive leaf-contrast eigenvalue whenever p+q>=3. For p=q=1 the explicit kernel vector (b-a,a,-b) is shown by three diagonal moments and kernel dimension one follows from odd-coordinate parity. Full-matrix numerical projector checks passed 245 cases; exact rational determinant equality checked in 192 cases. Infinite theorem is proved analytically, not extrapolated from computations.

value.rationale: Weighted hub-and-spoke Laplacian quantum walks naturally model heterogeneous coherent transport. Their long-time average-mixing matrix has a meaningful invertibility/kernel invariant. The theorem provides a complete exact classification for two conductance classes with all positive real weights and all sizes; the size-two conductance-class obstruction and instantaneous rank restoration upon weight coalescence are mathematically structural rather than trivial reparametrizations or a small tabulated case. The boundary is handled explicitly; no unsupported downstream applications are required.
